title: Preserve tool ownership while exposing scoped ACP tools to inference
goal: Vision: V-6. Supply session-owned tool schemas to GEMI and fulfill their calls through the existing tool bus without changing genuinely caller-owned tools or leaking fleet diagnostics onto ACP stdout. Parent T-CODEX100KACPBRIDGE-1 owns actual root wiring and integration.

reuse.reason: Reuse existing inference and tool dispatch without a new provider loop, tool registry, dependency or credential serialization. This closes a standards functionality gap and is not a size reduction.

limitations: Parent owns integration, executable end-to-end validation and publication. No external posts or pushes.
Focused GEMI tests use deterministic local fixtures; no paid or external inference.
GEMI bus fixture is not the production tools MAC implementation; parent root E2E and sibling tools tests validate actual MAC/evidence controls.
